insights.one_liner: DENSO Europe is the Amsterdam regional HQ of Japanese car-parts giant DENSO, a recognised visa sponsor whose current posting mentions visa support.

culture.text: DENSO International Europe is the regional headquarters for European affiliates of DENSO Corporation, one of the largest automotive technology suppliers.
Its products are part of nearly every major vehicle brand worldwide.

open.text: Denso Europe B.V. and Denso International Europe B.V. are IND recognised visa sponsors.
